objective: Make `mise run verify` runnable in this container by installing mise and the canary Bun the repository's toolchain needs.
scope: The repository's gates run through mise (`mise.toml`): it pins bun 1.4.4 and a postinstall hook upgrades it to canary (`bun scripts/toolchain.ts upgrade`); the `toolchain` task fails on a non-canary Bun. Currently `mise` is not installed and `bun --version` is 1.4.4 stable.

Install mise for the current user (official installer `curl https://mise.run | sh`, which puts it in ~/.local/bin; outbound HTTPS goes through a proxy, see /root/.ccr/README.md if TLS or 403 problems). Then in /home/user/holyagent run `mise trust`, `mise install`, and confirm `mise exec -- bun --version` is a canary build and `mise run toolchain` passes. Then run `mise run verify` once in /home/user/holyagent (branch claude/intelligent-dijkstra-x7njap, clean tree at main's 7d8c8bc) to prove the gates run, and report its pass/fail counts as the baseline.
Report the exact command a later agent should use to run the gates (e.g. `~/.local/bin/mise run verify` or a PATH export).
constraints: Do not edit any tracked repository file. `bun install` creating or updating node_modules is fine. Make no git commits, checkouts, merges or edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Do not touch the worktrees ../holyagent-state-off-main, ../holyagent-cli-stdin or ../holyagent-plugin-only-install.
Keep working until done; stop and report when the toolchain works. If installation is blocked (network, proxy), report the exact error.

criteria.text: mise run toolchain passes in /home/user/holyagent with a canary Bun
mise run verify ran to completion in /home/user/holyagent and its result is reported as the baseline
